scope: Bounded CPU/JavaScript Number (binary64), planar Plummer kernel; no GPU execution, production promotion, or throughput claim.

protocol.selection: Mutual theta 0.3 selected in a preceding pilot sweep; these seeded states are qualification fixtures, not an independent held-out accuracy estimate.
protocol.smallN: Four additional N8/32 disc/collision cases retain whole-solve overhead and direct-equivalent behavior; they are not scaling evidence.
protocol.memory: Before/after process.memoryUsage snapshots bracket whole solves outside the timed spans while the returned tree remains live. HeapUsed/RSS/arrayBuffers deltas are noisy process observations, can be negative from GC, and are not peak or isolated retained-allocation estimates. Tree node/leaf counts and 9*8 bytes/node of mutual local-coefficient payload are reproducible structural diagnostics, not total memory.
protocol.forceWorkloads: 12 seeded disc/collision states at N128/512 plus two bounded N2048 states; full independent symmetric direct forces for every body.
protocol.accuracy: Per-body relative errors use max(|direct acceleration|, 1e-30); p50/p90/p95/p99 use linear interpolation. The inherited browser BH gates are RMS < 0.03 and max < 0.25.
protocol.balance: Normalized internal force is |sum m*a| / max(sum m*|a|,1e-30). No mean-force subtraction or post-hoc balancing.
protocol.matching: BH theta grid 0:0.025:1; choose closest achieved RMS among inherited-budget-passing candidates. RMS match means BH/mutual ratio in [0.8,1.25]. p99 and maximum are separately reported; matching is per state, not a portable theta equivalence.
protocol.timing: Both implementations execute in the same native Node realm (no asymmetric vm wrapper). Two warmup solves and nine measured solves, alternating method order. Timed whole calls include validation, allocations, fresh tree construction, moments, traversal, and propagation. Diagnostics, direct oracle comparison, and calibration are outside the timed call. No forced GC; JIT/GC/scheduling noise remains. Raw wall times only.
protocol.integration: Shared-step kick-drift-kick with a fresh force state after every drift and cached boundary acceleration: steps+1 solves. Six N128 states, duration 0.064, dt=.001 and dt/2=.0005. Every step measures exact all-pairs Plummer potential plus kinetic energy, momentum, ballistic COM, angular momentum, and torque.
protocol.conservationBoundary: Linear momentum qualification does not imply angular momentum or energy conservation. Torque and energy are diagnostics, not qualification guarantees; tree switching can affect both.
